title: 37140 跟进：资料包（ai_context）的作者错误在保存时报出
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic #36996 handed to this project), from the #37173 contract review, R7 (comment 7149757761). ADR-0160 D1 says author defects are "reported at save and by `os validate`". #37173 ships the `os validate` half only.
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p2 (must land before row 7, the Studio form, #37143) · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 背景：资料包写错了，比如字段名拼错、关联列表指向不存在的对象，现在只有命令行 `os validate` 会报。在运行时或 Studio 里存的资料包，错了没人告诉作者，AI 读到的就是少了几项的资料。
- 要做的：保存资料包时就跑同一套检查，把错误告诉作者。
- 要你做的：无。

## What
1. Wire `validateAiContext` (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-context.ts`, CLI-only today, `authoring-rules.ts`) into the runtime metadata save path for `ai_context`. It needs a read of the object schema snapshot the rule judges against.
2. A save with a defect answers the same rule ids and messages that `os validate` prints. Decide, and state in the PR, whether a save with a defect is refused or saved with warnings, following the precedent other kinds set at save.
3. `get_record_context` stays silent on author defects; this card does not change the tool.

## Acceptance
- A runtime-created pack with a misspelled field or an unknown related object reports the defect at save. Pin each rule family.
- Lands before #37143 (row 7, the Studio form).

Parent: #36996. Related: #37140, #37173, #37143.
